name: Terminal Management Action Result 5 Code
definition: Final result of the processed terminal management action.

ACCD.name: Access Denied
ACCD.definition: Access is denied while performing the action.

CNTE.name: Connection Error
CNTE.definition: Problem to connect while performing the action.

FMTE.name: Format Error
FMTE.definition: Data transferred has a wrong format.

INVC.name: Invalid Content
INVC.definition: Content of the data is invalid.

LENE.name: Length Error
LENE.definition: Data transferred has a wrong length.

OVER.name: Memory Overflow
OVER.definition: Memory to store the date exceeded.

MISS.name: Missing File
MISS.definition: Data set to be maintained is missing.

SIGE.name: Signature Error
SIGE.definition: Data transferred has a wrong digital signature.

WARN.name: Success With Warning
WARN.definition: Action was performed but some warnings arose.

SYNE.name: Syntax Error
SYNE.definition: Data transferred has a wrong syntax.

TIMO.name: Timeout
TIMO.definition: Timeout expired during the data transfer.

UKRF.name: Unknown Key Reference
UKRF.definition: Cryptographic key reference used for the data signature is not valid.

INDP.name: Invalid Delegation Proof
INDP.definition: Delegation Proof transmitted by the delegated TMS is not the one expected.

IDMP.name: Invalid Delegation In Management Plan
IDMP.definition: One action of the AcceptorManagementPlan refers to an update unauthorized by the delegation.

DPRU.name: Delegation Parameters Received Unauthorized
DPRU.definition: The content analysis of the AcceptorConfigurationUpdate reveals unexpected parameters.

AERR.name: Any Error
AERR.definition: This code value means all TerminalManagementActionResultCode except "Any Error" and "Unlisted Error".

CMER.name: Communication Error
CMER.definition: Error in communication once the connection has been established.

ULER.name: Unlisted Error
ULER.definition: Any error that is not defined by a code value inside the TerminalManagementActionResultCode.
